<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:versionCode="3"
    android:versionName="1.2.3"
    android:compileSdkVersion="36"
    android:compileSdkVersionCodename="16"
    package="com.reaforweb.tinynotes"
    platformBuildVersionCode="36"
    platformBuildVersionName="16">
    <uses-sdk
        android:minSdkVersion="24"
        android:targetSdkVersion="34"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED"/>
    <application
        android:label="TinyNotes"
        android:allowBackup="false">
        <activity
            android:name="com.reaforweb.tinynotes.MainActivity"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
        <service
            android:name="com.reaforweb.tinynotes.SyncService"
            android:exported="false"/>
        <receiver
            android:name="com.reaforweb.tinynotes.BootReceiver"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>
        <provider
            android:name="com.reaforweb.tinynotes.NotesProvider"
            android:exported="false"
            android:authorities="com.reaforweb.tinynotes.notes"/>
    </application>
</manifest>
